title: ModulationConstellation
description: Wave-structure modulation constellation for HX-241. Maps bit patterns to combinations of independently controllable wave properties. This is ONE possible modulation approach within HX-241's carrier-agnostic framework, not a requirement.

capacity_bits.description: Total bits encodable per wave symbol (sum of log2(states) per dimension)

num_states.description: Total number of distinguishable wave structures (product of states across dimensions)

enabled_dimensions.description: List of modulation dimensions used in this scheme

bit_assignment.description: Bit pattern assigned to this constellation point

dimension_assignments.description: Mapping from dimension name to state value for this point

field_shape.description: Shape of the generated wave field

total_power.description: Total power of the generated wave field

duration.description: Temporal duration of the wave field

constellation.description: All constellation points with their bit assignments and dimension mappings

hx241_mapping.rust_type: User-defined modulation layer (not part of HX-241 core protocol)
hx241_mapping.rust_location: Application layer or optional transport extension
hx241_mapping.status: Optional - HX-241 does not mandate any specific modulation
hx241_mapping.note: Conventional QAM/OFDM/modulation can be added as alternative implementations
